verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment separate from production is a fair question for a model-serving platform with a cloud API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents one. Local execution and privacy claims ("Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine") describe data locality, not an isolated test environment or a dry-run mode, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
